title: IVG Pro Salts Blue Raspberry Ice 10ml E-Liquid
description: IVG Pro Nic Salts Blue Raspberry Ice 10ml E-Liquid offers a classic, vividly sweet vaping experience with a cooling twist. This expertly balanced profile captures the rich, confectionery-inspired taste of sweet Blue Raspberry, delivering a smooth and fruity inhale. A brisk layer of Ice then washes over the palate on the exhale, providing a clean and frosty contrast that prevents the sweetness from becoming overwhelming. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. IVG Pro Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits, serving as a highly cost-effective alternative to single-use or prefilled systems. The IVG Pro Salts collection takes the globally revered flavour profiles from the beloved IVG Pro prefilled pod range and makes them available in convenient 10ml bottles. As a multi-award-winning UK brand, IVG ensures exceptional quality across a massive selection of e-liquids. Beyond the frosty sweetness of Blue Raspberry Ice, vapers can explore other standout blends such as the nostalgic Cola GB or the pure cooling sensation of Classic Menthol, ensuring a premium option for every palate.
